content: Womu ɡe Asɑfu u kuɑ. Ge wee.

content.text: Gusunɔ, wee tɔn tukobu bɑ wunɛn tem wɔri.
Bɑ derɑ wunɛn sɑ̃ɑ yeru tɑ disi duurɑ.
Bɑ derɑ Yerusɑlɛmu yɑ kuɑ bɑnsu.
Bɑ wunɛn tɔmbu ɡo,
mɑ bɑ derɑ ɡunɔsu ben ɡonu di.
Bɑ derɑ ɡbeeku yɛɛ yi be, be bɑ nun sɑ̃ɑmɔ min ɡonu temɑ.
Bɑ ben yɛm yɑri mu kɑ Yerusɑlɛmu sikerenɛ nɡe nim,
mɑ bɑ ben ɡonu deri mi, ɡoo kun nu sikuɑ.
Be bɑ kɑ sun sikerenɛ bɑ sun wɔmmɔ.
Bɛsɛn berusebu bɑ sun yɑɑkoru mɔ̀.
Yinni Gusunɔ, sere sɑɑ yerɑ̀ wunɛn mɔru ko n seewɑ.
Sere sɑɑ yerɑ̀ kɑɑ n nisinu seewɑ nɡe dɔ̃ɔ.
A de wunɛn mɔru yu wɔri bwese ni nu ǹ nun yɛ̃
kɑ ni nu ǹ nun sɑ̃ɑmɔ sɔɔ.
Domi bɑ Isirelibɑ ɡo, mɑ ben tem mu kuɑ bɑnsu.
A ku sun bɛsɛn sikɑdobɑn durum sɔbi.
Adɑmɑ wunɛn kĩrun sɔ̃, ɑ sun wɔnwɔndu kuo.
Domi sɑ kuɑ wɔnwɔndobu.
Gusunɔ bɛsɛn fɑɑbɑ kowo, ɑ sun somiɔ
kpɑ wunɛn yĩsiru tu bɛɛrɛ wɑ.
A sun wɔro kpɑ ɑ sun bɛsɛn durum wɔkɑ.
Mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ kɑɑ de bwesenu nu n mɔ̀,
mɑnɑ bɛsɛn Yinni u wɑ̃ɑ.
A be bɑ wunɛn tɔmbun yɛm yɑri mɔru kɔsieyo
bwesenun suunu sɔɔ bɛsɛn wuswɑɑɔ.
Yinni Gusunɔ, ɑ dɛsobun weeweenu nɔɔwɔ,
kpɑ ɑ be bɑ kɑ dɔɔ bu ɡo fɑɑbɑ ko kɑ wunɛn dɑm.
Yinni, bwese ni nu kɑ nun sikerenɛ nu nun wɔnwɑ,
ɑ nu nin durum kɔsieyo sere nɔn nɔɔbɑ yiru.
Adɑmɑ bɛsɛ wunɛn tɔn be ɑ kpɑre, sɑ ko nun tɔmɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ,
kpɑ bɛsɛ kɑ bɛsɛn bibun bweseru sɑ n nun bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃ɛmɔ.
